body.query: Recent corporate action announcements by OneMedNet Corp (Nasdaq: ONMD): reverse stock split, CUSIP or identifier change, redemption, or ticker change
body.systemPrompt: You are scanning a watchlist for an investment operations team. Report the most recent corporate action announced for OneMedNet Corp (Nasdaq: ONMD), either by the issuer itself or in an official exchange or SEC notice: a reverse or forward stock split, a CUSIP or ticker change, a name change, an ADS ratio change, or a redemption, tender offer or exchange offer for this security. Ignore every other company and every other security. Ignore earnings, dividends, buybacks, share offerings, lawsuits, law-firm advertisements and analyst commentary. If no such action appears in the sources, write none found for event_type and not stated for every other field. Copy dates and times exactly as the source writes them. Write not stated for any field the source does not give. Never infer.

identifier_in_source.description: Ticker or CUSIP of the affected security exactly as the source prints it, or not stated

event_type.description: One of: reverse split, forward split, CUSIP change, ticker change, name change, ADS ratio change, redemption, tender offer, exchange offer, other, none found

terms.description: Split ratio, or redemption price and amount, as stated

effective_as_stated.description: Effective date and time exactly as the source writes it

effective_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the first trading day on the new terms for a split, or the redemption date for a bond, or not stated

new_identifier.description: New CUSIP or new ticker as stated, or not stated

source_notice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed on the notice itself

results.author: OneMedNet Corporation

OneMedNet Corporation Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Stock

# OneMedNet Corporation Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Stock Split

 September 25, 2026 11:50 ET | Source: OneMedNet Corporation 

MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- OneMedNet Corporation (Nasdaq: ONMD) (the “Company,” “we,” or “our”), a leading provider of first-party (direct-from-source) regulatory decision-grade, AI-driven Real-World Data (RWD), today announced that it will implement a 1-for-10 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding shares of common stock (the “Reverse Stock Split”), effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on September 29, 2026. The Reverse Stock Split was approved by the Company’s stockholders at its Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on September 18, 2026, with the final ratio, within the range approved by stockholders, subsequently determined by the Company’s board of directors. The Reverse Stock Split is intended to bring the Company into compliance with the minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market, and to broaden investor interest.

The Company’s common stock is expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis when the markets open on September 29, 2026 under the Company’s existing trading symbol “ONMD” with the new CUSIP number 68270C 202.

At the effective time of the Reverse Stock Split, every ten (10) shares of the Company’s issued and outstanding common stock will be automatically combined and converted into one issued and outstanding share of common stock without any change in the par value per share. The Reverse Split will reduce the number of shares of outstanding common stock from approximately 59,286,450 shares, the number of shares outstanding as of September 24, 2026, to approximately 5,928,645 shares of common stock. The total authorized number of shares will not be reduced. The Reverse Stock Split will also proportionately adjust the number of shares available under the Company’s equity incentive plans and the exercise price and number of shares underlying outstanding restricted stock units, warrants, and other equity instruments, in each case in accordance with their terms.

results.title: CDT Equity Inc. Announces Reverse Stock Split
results.author: CDT Equity Inc.
highlights:
NAPLES, Fla. and CAMBRIDGE, United Kingdom, Sept. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CDT Equity Inc. (Nasdaq: CDT) (“CDT” or the “Company”), announces that its board of directors has approved a 1-for-25 reverse stock split of the Company’s common stock, to ensure continued compliance with the Nasdaq bid-price rule. The Company’s stockholders approved future reverse stock splits, their timing, and granted the board of directors authority to determine future exact split ratios.

The reverse stock split will become effective on September 28, 2026, at 5:00 pm, Eastern Time (the “Effective Time”), and the Company’s common stock is expected to begin trading on a reverse stock split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Capital Market (“Nasdaq”) at market open under the existing ticker symbol, “CDT” on September 29, 2026, the date which has been approved by Nasdaq for the effectiveness of such split.
...
The Company’s common stock will continue to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol “CDT” following the reverse stock split, with a new CUSIP number of 20678X700. After the effectiveness of the reverse stock split, the number of outstanding shares of common stock will be reduced to approximately 1,013,515. No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the reverse stock split, and stockholders who would otherwise be entitled to a fractional share will receive a proportional cash payment.
